announcement_rule: SEC 8-K with Item 2.02 accepted on the run date at or before 23:59 US/Eastern
sample_filter: Russell 3000 proxy (top 3,000 US filers by 10-K public float) and >=1 analyst estimate (Nasdaq/Zacks)

information_sets.firm: seasonal random walk, SRW with drift, Brown-Rozeff SARIMA(1,0,0)(0,1,1)4; equal weights
information_sets.industry: pooled OLS of ROE_t+k on roe, roe_seas, loss, loss_x_roe, ind_med, ind_seas over FF48 peers
information_sets.country: industry model plus cty_med, cty_chg, gdp_yoy, term_spread, rf_10y
information_sets.all: equal-weight average of firm, industry and country EPS forecasts

valuation.cost_of_equity: 10y Treasury + Blume beta (60 monthly returns vs SPY) x Damodaran implied ERP
